name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives an AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers what you built and decided yesterday instead of starting from zero every time you open a new session.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team who uses AI coding assistants daily and is tired of re-explaining their project's context in every new chat session.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it to stop losing hours re-explaining a client's codebase to their AI assistant after every restart.
A dev-tools company sells a hosted, managed version of this memory layer (the project already has a 'CMEM Pro' hosted option) so teams don't self-host it.
An agency running many AI-assisted client projects in parallel uses it to keep each project's context cleanly separated and persistent across its team.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted/managed memory service as a monthly subscription (the project is already testing this model).
Offer a usage-based API for teams who want persistent agent memory without managing infrastructure.

steal_this: Set it up for your own coding workflow this weekend, then write up the before/after time savings as a case study you can use to pitch a 'set this up for your team' service to other small dev shops.
